import sys,json,threading
from pathlib import Path
from functools import partial
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
import ui_visual_quality_test as h
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
server=h.BrowserFixtureServer(('127.0.0.1',0),partial(h.planning.Quiet,directory=str(h.ROOT)))
threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
report={'cases':[]}
try:
 with sync_playwright() as pw:
  browser=pw.chromium.launch(**h.launch_options())
  try:h.counterproofs(browser,f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/index.html',report)
  finally:browser.close()
finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close()
Path('/private/tmp/jpw-visual-measurement-20261025/wiring-counterproofs-confirmed.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print([(c['id'],c['classification']) for c in report['cases']])
assert len(report['cases'])==4 and all(c['classification']=='PASS' for c in report['cases'])
case=next(c for c in report['cases'] if c['id']=='counterproof-forecast-inner-text')
assert 'batched_measurement_counterproofs' in case['evidence']
